# Waline client 3.16.1

Unmodified full client and stylesheet from `@waline/client@3.16.1/dist/`.
Source repository: https://github.com/walinejs/waline/tree/main/packages/client
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@waline/client@3.16.1/dist/
License: MIT, see LICENSE. The client bundles Vue and its other dependencies.

SHA-256 checksums are recorded in docs/reading-tools.md. Keep the client and
stylesheet at the same version, preserve the license, and run the reading and
comment submission browser checks when upgrading. Serving these files from
GitHub Pages removes the separate CDN dependency; the API still needs a reachable
HTTPS server address.
